philosophy.reverseRule: Every scrubbed scroll animation moves backwards naturally when scrolling up. Entrance animations use 'play none none reverse'. All elements release to transform: none at rest for subpixel text sharpness.
philosophy.smoothScroll: Lenis smooth scroll with lerp 0.09 driven by GSAP ticker with lagSmoothing(0). Touch devices use native momentum scrolling.
philosophy.canvasBudget: Strict maximum of 1 WebGL canvas active across any viewport.

directives.name: tilt-in
directives.behavior: Perspective 1200px tilt-in from rotateX(10deg) scrubbed from top 95% to top 40%, releases to transform: none on leave.

directives.name: stage-recede
directives.behavior: Smoothly scales down to 0.94 and recedes in 3D perspective as user scrolls down.

directives.name: rise-stagger
directives.behavior: Children stagger rise 20px with power2.out ease, triggered at top 92% with fastScrollEnd and clearProps onComplete.

directives.name: split-lines
directives.behavior: Lines reveal from horizon mask with rotateX(-15deg) to 0, descender safe padding 0.15em.

directives.name: flip-rows
directives.behavior: Staggered 3D flip from rotateX(-18deg) to 0, clearing props at rest.

directives.name: depth-in
directives.behavior: Subtle scale and z-depth entrance with toggleActions: 'play none none reverse'.

directives.name: magnetic
directives.behavior: Spring-damped button pull with mouse-following trajectory.
